hero.lead: Serving boards, platters, coasters and wine glasses in the Ocean, Mountain and Lava ranges. Choose a piece and your edge finish, order online, and pay by a secure link.

about.name: Amanda Gratwick
about.p1: I’m Amanda Gratwick, the maker behind Outside The Lines Studio. I make serving boards, platters, coasters and wine glasses by hand, finished in one of three ranges: Ocean, Mountain or Lava.
about.p2: No two pieces match. The timber, the colour and the resin change from one piece to the next, so every piece you receive is one of a kind.
about.p3: [A few lines on how you started, where you work and what you enjoy most about making each piece.]

ordering.title: How ordering works
ordering.intro: Every piece is handmade to order from the options you choose.

steps.title: Choose a piece
steps.text: Browse the shop and pick the type, shape, size and range you like, then choose resin edges or clean edges.

steps.title: Place your order
steps.text: Press Order this piece and send your name and email. We reply with your order details.

steps.title: Pay by secure link
steps.text: When you have chosen, we send a secure payment link. You pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

steps.title: We pack and post

faqs.a: Choose a piece, pick your size and edge finish (resin edges or clean edges), then press Order this piece. We email you a secure payment link and post your piece once it is paid.
Yes. Every piece is handmade, so the timber, the colours and the shape of the resin change from one to the next. The pictures on the site are illustrations of each type.

faqs.q: What are the two types of resin finish?
faqs.a: Resin edges: the resin runs down the sides of the piece as well as through the middle, so the colour wraps right round the edge. Clean edges: the timber edges stay natural all the way round and the resin is kept to the surface. You choose between the two from the Edge finish drop-down on each board and platter. [Amanda to confirm and add anything about how each is made or cared for.]
